name: Balance Sheet Review — At-Death Modelling Declined
query: So where does everything actually land at death for the Bradys?
expected_behavior: Step 1: Recognizes this is at-death modelling — not in this release — and does not attempt it
Step 2: Declines plainly, and adds that on this household it would be misleading anyway because the accounts are not matched to the trust
Step 3: Offers to stay on what is owned, or on what the documents say, as the single next step
Step 4: Does not name a report, a scenario, an estate flow, or any other out-of-release capability
success_criteria: The answer states at-death modelling is not something this release does, in plain language
No distribution figure, per-beneficiary amount, or modelled outcome appears
No dollar total attributed to what anyone receives appears
The offer to stay on assets or documents is the single next step, phrased as a question
The refusal does not describe a scenario, report, or heritage-map capability existing elsewhere
must_not: any modelled at-death or distribution figure
any statement that ownership matches the estate plan
naming a report, scenario, what-if, estate flow, heritage map, risk analysis, or insights capability
a guess at the at-death outcome hedged with 'roughly' or 'probably'
